programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: E4 - Fun Facts About The World!
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He & D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors & why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert & helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: E5 - JJ & Nina's Artsy August Dance Craze
programme.desc: Let's create a dance for Artsy August! Follow along as JJ, Mochi, and Kiki lead each other in fun new steps. Then, play Red-Light Green-Light, do a silly animal dance, pretend you're a graceful ballerina, and draw cool shapes with chalk!

programme.title: E5 - Super Creative Day of Play
programme.desc: Get ready for a super creative day of play with Twinkle! First, it's time to get musical! Each toadstool makes a different musical note, allowing Twinkle & Sandy the Seagull to create a musical tune. Then, get creative as Twinkle has fun painting a picture of what she sees. The fun continues as Twinkle shares a box full of super fun toys, & her friends learn how to play new musical instruments!

programme.title: E1 - A Super Fun Underwater Sing-Along!
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty & a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: E1 - The Ultimate Teamwork & Rescue Special!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork & rescue special with Kii & Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii & Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well & needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii & Yii always save the day!

programme.title: E10 - Baby John's Artsy August Day
programme.desc: Let's get baking this Artsy August! Follow a picture cookbook with Baby John and Manny to make muffins, but get ready for a mess! Then, celebrate Dia de los Muertos, build toy boats, and have a fun, paint-splattering race in the garden!

programme.title: E5 - Jill's Artsy August Masterpiece
programme.desc: Express yourself this Artsy August! Join Jill as she learns to handle frustration when her painting goes wrong. Then, join a sled race, discover your own special talent, and decorate a pair of super sparkly new shoes!

programme.desc: It's makeover time for Artsy August! Give Mom a wild new look with crazy makeup and pink hair. Then, fix your friends' broken items with crafts on the bus, hunt for treasure as a mermaid, and play detective to find a missing bunny!

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: E1 - Bound By Blood
programme.desc: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealand’s South Island. Face forest penguins’ feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

programme.title: E2 - Life in Dark Water
programme.desc: Learn how winter’s arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

programme.title: E1 - Deadly Intruders
programme.desc: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

programme.title: E2 - Snake Face Off
programme.desc: Launch into spring’s snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

programme.title: E3 - Reptile Runabout
programme.desc: Weave through Queensland’s coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

programme.title: E5 - Chasing Scales
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: E6 - Home Invasion
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: E1 - Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: E2 - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: E3 - Rocco, Harold and Cindy

programme.title: E21
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾。

programme.desc: Feature documentary studying the history of the sharks species, alongside their anatomy and how they’ve helped our oceans for hundreds of millions of years. However, in the modern age they face extinction and demonisation. Over 1000 million sharks are killed every year, and it is up to us to save them.

programme.desc: Mike vists Iceland to catch Atlantic salmon and meet a wild food chef. Part 1.

programme.desc: Mike camps out at a secret lake to catch monster pike and feed his hosts, the Meade Pike Club.

programme.desc: Mario takes on the unforgiving alpine mountains of the south island of New Zealand in a gruelling fallow deer hunt with his bow at the end of the rutt and cooks an impressive venison pie dish on the same antler of the deer he harvests.

programme.title: Hanggang Sa Huling Milya
programme.desc: (Until the Last Mile) is a 2026 documentary by journalist Victoria Tulad that gives a glimpse into the lives of students and educators in Pulong Mindanao Elementary School (PMES) in Santa Maria, Laguna. PMES is just one of the 9,000 'last mile schools' in the Philippines, those that are located in geographically isolated and disadvantaged areas (GIDAs). The documentary also looks into the persistent challenges in the education sector such as multilevel teaching situations due to insufficient number of teachers and shortage of classrooms.

programme.desc: A tribute to Canadian Francophonie with guinea fowl breast, roasted cauliflower, mussels, and butter tarts. With chefs Etienne Croteau and John Winter Russell, singer Damien Robitaille, and artist Edith Butler.

programme.title: E32 - Family Home With Zen Decoration
programme.desc: Visit of a family house with soft and zen decoration that invites to rest and disconnect in the north of France. Also: discovery of the farm of Petit Bomal; a point with Anne on photovoltaic; how to mount a fence in chestnut.

programme.title: E14 - Simone Pheulpin/Julian Klausner/Sophie Brillouet
programme.desc: The Albert-Kahn museum unveils the banker's humanist project. Sometimes called 'the time folder', Simone Pheulpin works with cotton ribbon. For his first show at Dries Van Noten, Julian Klausner plays with textures and colours. Sophie Brillouet's studio is alive with beach air.

programme.title: E12 - Alone In The World
programme.desc: Alexis and Thomas are in complete autonomy deep in the remote wilderness of Kluane National Park. Facing unpredictable weather and no emergency support, their knowledge is put to the test.

programme.title: E21 - Martinican Culture
programme.desc: On the programme: meeting craftspeople dedicated to passing on their skills in Le Robert; discovering the unique landscape of the Savane des Petrifications; immersion in the heart of Carnival parades...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Chin Siu Ho
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode!

programme.title: Mr Fortune
programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed...

programme.title: The Cat
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely...

programme.title: Fight Back To School III
programme.desc: The Millionaire, Million Wong, is found dead in a hotelroom. The police head officer, Mr. Ta Wang Lai, orders Chau Sing Sing to be an undercover again for further investigation.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely...

programme.title: Porky's Meatballs
programme.desc: A new school term begins. Vivacious high school girl Jane hurries back to Hong Kong from overseas, where she spent her vacation. Chinese-American college student Wan Ho follows her all the way to Hong Kong to get close to her. But Jane is so popular in school and is used to having boys around her. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Meanwhile, Pak Yat Moon has a crush on Wan Ho, and Ka Ming has crush on Pak Yat Moon! It is a total mess and the relationships become utterly chaotic! Everything culminates in a showdown during a big basketball game...
